text.autoconfig.bedrockmotion.title: BedrockMotion
text.autoconfig.bedrockmotion.option.ena: Turns the whole mod on or off. Saving a change reloads the resource packs.
text.autoconfig.bedrockmotion.option.rep: Lets Bedrock packs animate and extend the player model. Packs that attach things to the player, like Smooth Moves with its toolbelt, need this.
text.autoconfig.bedrockmotion.option.par: Multiplies the size of Bedrock particles. Allowed range 0.05 to 8, default 1.
text.autoconfig.bedrockmotion.option.bas: File names inside bedrockmotion/packs that only supply animations, geometries and textures to the packs above them, like the vanilla Bedrock pack. Names starting with base_ count automatically. Saving a change reloads the resource packs.
text.autoconfig.bedrockmotion.option.fea: Bedrock models, animations and render controllers on entities.
Poses the vanilla model with the Bedrock animation when an entity has animations but no Bedrock model of its own.
Bedrock attachables: held items, armor and other models worn by entities.
Runs the pack's parent setups and worn-gear logic on living entities.
Bedrock particle effects started by animations and entities.
Items built from a flat texture, like the held items of Bedrock attachables.
Sound effects played by Bedrock animations.
